name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri Volkov's journey into the heart of motorsport began not on the track, but in the machine shop. Growing up in a family of engineers, he developed a keen understanding of mechanics and a passion for pushing technological boundaries. After earning a degree in Engineering, he quickly transitioned into racing, starting as a junior mechanic and rapidly ascending through the ranks.

Volkov's ascent to Team Principal of Hansen World RX Team is a testament to his unwavering dedication and innovative thinking. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member's voice is heard, but ultimately takes responsibility for the strategic direction of the team. Known for his meticulous planning and ability to spot emerging talent, Dimitri is driven by a desire to not just win races, but to shape the future of rallycross.

What distinguishes Dimitri is his ability to balance a data-driven approach with a human touch. He analyzes telemetry with laser focus, but understands that motivation and team morale are crucial for peak performance. He is known for his motivational speeches and his unique ability to keep his drivers calm under pressure.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Dimitri is a man of average height with a serious, focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in the paddock
Drinks copious amounts of strong black coffee throughout the day
Has a habit of pacing when under pressure
